source_refs.note: Length Contraction: a main subheading of 11.3 Special theory of relativity, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 253-253.

blocks.text: Chalte spaceship mein baithe observer ko zameen se kisi sitare tak ka faasla zameen wale observer ke naape hue faasle se kam lagega. Yani agar aap do aise points ke relative chal rahe hain jin ka faasla fixed hai, to yeh faasla us se chhota lagta hai jo ruk kar naapne par milta. Is effect (asar) ko length contraction kehte hain. Length sirf motion ki direction (simt) mein chhoti hoti hai; motion ke perpendicular (90° par) koi farq nahi parta. Jo observer cheez ke relative ruka hua ho, us ki naapi hui length proper length ℓₒ kehlati hai. Agar cheez aur observer ek doosre ke relative speed v se chal rahe hon, to chhoti hui length ℓ yeh hai:

Ek train ruki hui halat mein 100 metre lambi hai aur light ki speed ke 80% (0.8 c) se chalti hai. Andar wala shakhs us ki length 100 metre hi naapega. Magar patri ke kinare khara shakhs train ko sirf 60 metre lamba dekhega (100 × √(1 − 0.64) = 100 × 0.6 = 60). Motion ki direction mein length ka yeh chhota hona length contraction hai.
